name: Veiled Core
description: Veil the core of the soul in layered ward so that no probing will can reach it.

name: Stray Cleanse
description: Cleanse stray hostile will from the veiled soul of an ally or the self.

name: Spread Sense
description: Spread a net of attention to find every soul that leans against the ward.

name: Pliant Slip
description: Let the ward go pliant at the point of a blow so that it passes round.

name: Layered Hold
description: Hold seven layers of ward in turn against a determined assault of many wills.

name: Outward Veil
description: Extend the veil over allies and lend each a layer of the user's own ward.

name: Revival Rite
description: Draw back a comrade whose soul has just been stunned from the edge of death through the ward.

name: Surge Reply
description: Return the full surge of an assault of wills along the line it came.

name: Deep Drink
description: Hollow the ward so that it drinks a barrage of hostile soul force whole.

name: Quiet Dominion
description: Lay a quiet dominion over a field of minds so that hostile will falls still.

name: Shared Aegis
description: Cover a whole company in one aegis and feed it from the core of the user.

name: Final Cover
description: The school's last cover that closes round all within reach and mends them with a depth set by the user's reserve.

name: Unbreached Soul
description: Turn the whole soul into a ward that unmakes an army of wills at the destructive ceiling of its tier.

name: Kindled Ward
description: Kindle the ward with divine force and let it glow against a hostile touch.

name: Burning Clear
description: Burn foreign taint from the soul of an ally with a clean divine fire.

name: Ember Sense
description: Read the glow of the ward for the weight and shape of a hostile soul.

name: Flint Turn
description: Flick a blow aside with a spark of divine force at the point of contact.

name: Glowing Hold
description: Hold the lit ward through a long assault with the glow growing as the blows land.

name: Kindled Gift
description: Kindle the wards of allies from the user's own so that all burn with the same steady light.

name: Flame Recall
description: Call back a fallen ally whose soul still flickers by feeding it divine light within the short window.

name: Burning Return
description: Return a hostile strike wrapped in the divine fire of the lit ward.

name: Furnace Drink
description: Draw a storm of soul force into the lit ward as a furnace draws air.

name: Radiant Silence
description: Pour bright silence over the field so that hostile wills dim and fall quiet.

name: Divine Mantle
description: Drape a divine mantle over allies that guards them and mends their souls.

name: Heart of Flame
description: The school's centre where the lit core takes in hostile force and gives it to allies in a measure set by the user's reserve.

name: Ignited Aegis
description: Light the whole ward with divine force and burn an assault of wills to nothing at the destructive ceiling of its tier.

name: Sunlit Vigil
description: Raise a sunlit vigil across the field that no hostile will enters and every ally is mended within at the ceiling of its tier.
